title: Orbit Putt — Gravity Golf
description: A mini-golf game where gravity wells bend every shot — putt, build your own courses, and share them as links.
concept: Aim a slingshot-style putt around attracting and repelling gravity wells to sink the ball in as few strokes as possible across an 8-hole campaign. Switch to Edit mode to place wells, draw obstacles, and reposition the start/hole, then save your course locally or share it as a URL/JSON file for anyone to play.
features: Physics-based putting: drag-to-aim slingshot shot with a real gravity simulation (inverse-square attract/repel wells, rolling friction, elastic bounces)
8-level campaign with increasing difficulty, par, and best-stroke tracking per level
Full level editor: place/move/erase gravity wells and rectangular obstacles, set start and hole, adjustable well strength and hole radius
Save custom levels to a local gallery, share any level as a copyable URL (base64-encoded in the hash) or download it as a JSON file
Persistent best scores and saved levels via localStorage
tech: Fixed-timestep physics loop decoupled from display refresh rate

interaction.mouse: Drag back from the ball and release to putt — power and direction follow the drag, like a slingshot
interaction.click: In Edit mode, click to place wells/obstacles/start/hole depending on the selected tool
interaction.touch: Same drag-to-aim gesture works with touch; edit toolbar buttons are thumb-sized
